title: Amortized Neural Filtering for Calibrated Posteriors in Statistical Arbitrage
abstract: arXiv:2610.25802v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Statistical arbitrage trades on an estimate of the state of a residual spread, and conventional practice discards the uncertainty of that estimate. We keep the uncertainty and use it in the trading decision. A Neural Filter Estimator (NFE) is trained on simulated paths of a mean-reverting process whose innovation law is selected by testing candidates against real residuals; once trained, it returns the posterior over the latent state of every spread in a cross-section in one forward pass. Three results follow. On simulated paths with known truth, every practical estimator, ours included, falls in one narrow band of accuracy well below an estimator given full information, so the posterior gains no accuracy over a point estimate; its contribution is a correct account of its own uncertainty. On Korean equities, net of costs, the conventional point estimate forecasts about a thousand basis points per holding period more than it realizes,

translated_title: 统计套利中面向校准后验的摊销神经滤波
translated_abstract: 统计套利基于对残差价差状态的估计进行交易，而传统做法会舍弃该估计的不确定性。我们保留这种不确定性，并将其用于交易决策。神经滤波估计器（NFE）在均值回归过程的模拟路径上进行训练，其新息分布律是通过将候选模型与真实残差进行检验来选定的；训练完成后，它只需一次前向传播即可返回横截面上每个价差潜在状态的后验分布。由此得出三个结果。在真值已知的模拟路径上，包括我们在内的所有实用估计器都落在远低于拥有完全信息估计器的一个狭窄精度区间内，因此后验在精度上并不优于点估计；其贡献在于对自身不确定性的正确刻画。在韩国股票市场上，扣除成本后，传统点估计在每个持有期所预测的收益比实际实现的高出约一千个基点，
tldr: 该论文提出神经滤波估计器（NFE），通过一次前向传播输出统计套利中残差价差潜在状态的校准后验分布，并将不确定性纳入交易决策，弥补了传统点估计因忽略不确定性而导致收益被高估的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Neural Filter Estimator (NFE) that amortizes calibrated posteriors over latent spread states in statistical arbitrage with a single forward pass, incorporating uncertainty into trading decisions to fix the overestimated returns of conventional point estimates.
